source: Communications Authority of Kenya (CA) Consumer Guidelines & MNO USSD Protocols

networks.name: Safaricom
networks.checkSubscriptionsStep: Dial *456*9*5# (or *100# → My Subscriptions) to view and cancel all active premium-rate SMS & content subscriptions.
networks.stopAllPromoSMS: Dial *456*9*5# to opt out of promotional sender IDs and marketing SMS, or send 'STOP' to the specific shortcode.
networks.checkLinkedSIMsStep: Dial *106# → Select option 1 (Check numbers registered with my ID) to identify and report fraudulent SIMs.

networks.name: Airtel Kenya
networks.checkSubscriptionsStep: Dial *100# → Select 'Manage My Account' → 'My Subscriptions' → Unsubscribe all.
networks.stopAllPromoSMS: Dial *100*3# or send 'STOP' to the deduction shortcode.
networks.checkLinkedSIMsStep: Dial *106# to review all MSISDN lines linked to your National ID card.

networks.name: Telkom Kenya
networks.checkSubscriptionsStep: Dial *100# → Option 4 (My Account) → Manage Active Services.
networks.stopAllPromoSMS: Send 'STOP' to the offending alphanumeric SMS shortcode or manage active services via *100#.
networks.checkLinkedSIMsStep: Dial *106# to verify all mobile numbers registered under your National ID.
